note: Frozen BEFORE any run. Five low-turnover, textbook-parameter hypotheses. No parameter is tuned. Multiple-testing: Bonferroni over 5 hypotheses (99% bootstrap bound).
data: staged RAW canonical bars (V8, NOT adjusted; phantom sessions quarantined). Months/positions containing an unresolved >11.5% close-to-close move (possible unrecorded corporate action) are excluded symmetrically for all strategies and the benchmark; the count is reported. Mostly single-provider non-official bars.

periods.true_out_of_sample: forward paper trading from 2026-11-06 with fresh official bars

universe: eligible at signal: ADV20 >= 5,000,000 EGP (so 250,000 EGP is <=5% of ADV20), valid close history for the lookback, no >11.5% jump in the lookback window
execution: signal at last session of each month t; entry at CLOSE of t+1; exit at CLOSE of t'+1 (next month's entry day); names kept across months incur no trade cost; official/auction open never used
portfolio: top N=10 equal-weight, 250,000 EGP per name

hypotheses.H3_mom_6_1_regime: H1, but invest only if the equal-weight eligible-universe index (cumulated mean daily return) closes above its 100-session mean at t; otherwise cash (0%)
hypotheses.H4_lowvol_60: rank stdev of daily returns over 60 sessions ascending (lowest first)

benchmark: equal-weight ALL eligible names, monthly, GROSS (no costs) - conservative for the strategies. Cash earns 0% in this test; the Egyptian risk-free rate is NOT in the database and is a real extra hurdle.
statistics: monthly net return series; mean, compounded annual, annualized stdev, Sharpe (rf=0), max drawdown; 3-month block bootstrap (5000 draws, seed 20261106) 99% lower bound of mean monthly net AND of mean monthly excess over benchmark
advance_rule: a hypothesis ADVANCES to forward paper trading only if on development: n_months >= 60, mean net > 0, 99% lower bound of mean excess over benchmark > 0, and positive mean excess in >= 6 of the 8 calendar years. If none qualifies: NO_STRATEGY_APPROVED stays. Advancing never licenses an executable recommendation.
reporting: 2025-01..2026-11 is exposed (earlier tests looked at it); it is reported as informational only and never used for selection.
